welcome.title: Welcome to xTheGospel Leaders
welcome.subtitle: A quick intro so you can get value from day one.

slides.title: What is this app?
slides.description: This app helps ward and stake leaders organize callings, coordination, and follow-up with clarity.

slides.title: What can you find here?
slides.description: You will find dashboards, callings management, notes, and practical tools for day-to-day leadership.

slides.title: Quick tutorial
slides.description: Start by signing in, choose your role, complete ward setup, and then review your dashboard and callings.

exploration.offlineBanner: You're offline—you can keep exploring. Ward membership will refresh when you're back online.
exploration.staleBanner: Ward data may be out of date.
exploration.emptyDescription: You can browse and use the whole app. To load cloud data and ward sessions, link a ward whenever you're ready from Connect ward or your profile.
exploration.needWardForAction: Link a ward to use this action with cloud data.

choose.title: Connect to your ward
choose.subtitle: As {{role}}, this step unlocks guidance for your duties according to your calling, block-based study plans for teachers, and the rest of your ward tools.
choose.createDesc: I'm the first in my ward to use the app
choose.joinDesc: My bishopric gave me a ward code
choose.noteNonBishopric: Ask your bishopric or executive secretary for your ward code.

create.title: Create your ward
create.subtitle: A unique code will be generated so other leaders can join

join.title: Join a ward
join.subtitle: Enter the 6-character code from your bishopric
join.helpBody: Ask your bishop, counselor, or executive secretary. They can find it in their profile in the app.

discovery.title: When you're ready to move forward
discovery.hint: Gentle shortcuts across ward tools. None of this competes with what is sacred.

callings.title: Callings
callings.subtitle: Review, create, or follow up calmly.

members.title: Members
members.subtitle: Care for people, not just records.

teachingStrip.title: For those who teach
teachingStrip.hint: Prepare your class at your pace. Here are your list and a new session.

sessions.title: My sessions
sessions.subtitle: Resume a class or review the plan.

newSession.title: New session
newSession.subtitle: Get a code and QR when you're ready.

calendarFallback.title: Calendar
calendarFallback.subtitle: Find the next space to teach.

canon.dashboardSubtitle: Organize callings and teaching with calm.
canon.dashboardHeroNote: Open each section calmly. Nothing here is urgent compared to sacred things.
canon.teachingSubtitle: Prepare and lead class sessions with clarity.
canon.teachingHeroNote: Create a session to get a code and QR. Support audio will be available soon.
canon.bishopSubtitle: Oversee ward classes with a pastoral view.
canon.sessionAudioSummary: Audio summary to prepare the class before you meet.
canon.sessionAudioIntent: A brief guide for tone and pacing of the lesson.
canon.sessionImagePrompt: A representative image or slide for the class, sober style. Coming soon.
canon.sessionHeroNote: Review the plan, activate the code when ready, and teach with the Spirit.
canon.reflectionBody: Before you teach, think of one person this lesson might help.
canon.reportHeroNote: Review the summary calmly. Export the PDF if you need to share it.
canon.sessionCreateSubtitle: Set title, class type, and parts before activating the code.
canon.sessionCreateHeroNote: You can edit the draft until you activate the session.
canon.sessionLiveHeroNote: Guide the current part and support participants with patience.
canon.analyticsSubtitle: Ward trends for the selected period.
canon.analyticsHeroNote: Use this data pastorally—not for judgment.
